privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.confirmation: I understand that my name, message and optional photo may appear publicly after moderation and that I can request removal.

privacy.scraps.title: Scraps and moderation
privacy.scraps.text: When you submit a scrap, you provide a name, a message and an optional photo. Lorkut stores those details in its database (the photo is referenced by URL and, for new submissions, by its identifier), along with a scrap ID, date and approval status. Only approved scraps appear in the public list. The form requires no account and does not store an IP address or browser details in the scrap record.
privacy.photos.title: Photos
privacy.photos.text: Cloudinary receives and stores the uploaded photo and provides its delivery URL. Anyone who knows that address can access the image. Moderation controls whether it appears on the portfolio. You can request removal of the photo or the scrap.
privacy.translation.title: On-demand translation
privacy.translation.text: When translation is enabled and you request it, the scrap text may be sent to DeepL. The original stays intact. The backend may cache the translation and detected language for reuse.
privacy.services.title: Hosting and links
privacy.services.text: Vercel hosts the frontend. Railway hosts the API and MySQL database. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts and includes links to WhatsApp, LinkedIn, GitHub and project websites. Those destinations have their own policies.
privacy.storage.title: Language preference
privacy.storage.text: The site saves your language preference in your browser’s local storage. You can clear it in your browser settings.
privacy.requests.title: Corrections and removal
privacy.requests.text: Use the site’s existing contact channel to request a correction or removal of a scrap or its photo. Include the name used and enough information to identify the scrap.
privacy.contact_message: Hello, I would like to request a correction or removal of a scrap or photo on Lorkut.

lorenaferreira.shortDescription: A living full-stack portfolio that brings the social web nostalgia of Orkut into a modern developer experience.
lorenaferreira.fullDescription: LorenaFerreira.dev is a living full-stack portfolio inspired by Orkut, the social network that became a defining part of internet culture in the 2000s, especially in Brazil and India. Rather than simply recreating its interface, the project brings its profiles, communities, scraps and nostalgic social interactions into a modern portfolio experience where my work, projects and professional evolution are continuously updated. Built with React and Vite on the frontend and Spring Boot with MySQL on the backend, it combines a recognizable piece of early social-web history with a real, evolving full-stack application deployed on Vercel and Railway.

claravision-optica.shortDescription: A complete management system for an optical store built with PHP and MySQL.
claravision-optica.fullDescription: ClaraVisión Óptica is a responsive CRUD application developed for managing an optical store. The system includes product and category management, database operations, JSON handling and a structured interface designed around practical business workflows. Built with PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript and deployed on InfinityFree.

curiofy.shortDescription: A minimalist random-fact application powered by a public API.
curiofy.fullDescription: Curiofy is a lightweight interactive web application that retrieves random facts from a public API on demand. It was built with a mobile-first approach, asynchronous data handling with the Fetch API and automated unit testing with Vitest. The project focuses on clean JavaScript architecture, accessibility, responsive design and a fast, straightforward user experience.

marinarodriiphoto.shortDescription: Multilingual photography portfolio with content management in development.
marinarodriiphoto.fullDescription: I built the React and Vite frontend and a Java API with Spring Boot and MySQL to organize the collection. I’m extending the admin area so Marina can manage her own imagery and publications.
features: Photo galleries and personal projects with photos and videos
REST API with Flyway migrations and Cloudinary media integration
Admin area in development for uploading, editing and publishing photos

aupairnaespanha.shortDescription: Resource platform for people planning to become au pairs in Spain.
aupairnaespanha.fullDescription: I build and maintain the React platform, including responsive pages about the program, courses and insurance. The free host-family guide uses a Brevo signup form and a dedicated download page.
features: PDF guide and Brevo signup integration
Build-generated SEO metadata for individual routes and a sitemap
Unit and browser tests for routes, navigation and responsive layouts
screenshotCaptions: Resources section on the Au Pair page

bmv-makeup.shortDescription: Responsive editorial portfolio for makeup artist Bruno Mënezess.
bmv-makeup.fullDescription: I built a four-language site to showcase makeup services, selected work and courses. The navigation guides visitors through each specialty and directs booking enquiries to WhatsApp.
features: Instagram feed with a serverless endpoint and fallback content
Responsive WebP images and Playwright tests

portuguese-with-thais.shortDescription: Brazilian Portuguese lessons website with booking and a placement test.
portuguese-with-thais.fullDescription: I built the responsive English-language site to present the teacher’s method, help visitors compare lesson options and book through Cal.com. The Brazilian Soul section collects cultural resources for learners.
features: 30-question placement test with an immediate result
Cultural guide, route metadata and Playwright tests
